_note: CUST-HV V9d-4 — commerce firewall (V0 §14.3). A hostile document: every scope the production normalizer accepts (document tokens, branding, header, footer, contact, whatsapp, social, verification, sbc, apps, navigation, pagePresentation, announcements, palette, homepage sections, section content, section design, design.cards, nested items) carries commercial keys (price, discount, stock, availability, tax, total, currency, sku, quantity, shipping fee / amount, freight, delivery fee, offer status, coupon code, cost). After normalisation NO such key may survive anywhere, and no injected value may be reachable. Shared by PHP StorefrontPresentationNormalizer and both TS twins (normalizePresentationConfig).
